rv.q: Most people are completely overwhelmed and amazed when they leave.
You will walk away in wonder as to how any of this can be accomplished.
Do not miss Spellbound. It plays at the SoHo Playhouse through September 6th, so you have two more performances to catch her.

cn.t: Mentalist Suhani Shah captivates audiences with seemingly impossible feats of mind-reading, delivered with charming ease and impish charisma that leaves skeptics overwhelmed and amazed.
